upgrades.changelog:
- Fixed LED color distortion for some colors at low brightness.
- Fixed the incorrect mapping of dimming duration (P1-P8).
- Fixed duration in the Switch Multilevel command.

- Added Group 7 for fan control.
- Added the ability to disable the relay when in OnOff + Full Wave mode.
- Fixed a situation where a lifeline report was not made when a multicast message was received.
- Resolved a bug in Association Group Behavior.
- Upgraded the Z-Wave SDK.
